mentions.name: WhyTorch
mentions.description: An interactive visual explainer site for PyTorch functions: clicking elements in tensors shows where each value came from and where it is used in the output, and the input tensors can be modified to explore behavior. Built as a side project by re-implementing PyTorch functions in JavaScript alongside the site framework, with more functions being added over time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making a visual explainer site for PyTorch functions:

https://whytorch.org/

A great example of how it works is http://whytorch.org/torch.amax/

Clicking items in the tensors explains where they came from and where they are used in the output. The input tensors can be modified too.
